board.empty_description: Pages are the site's own content — everything outside the news feed. Nothing is published, so /p/* returns 404 for now.
board.no_match_description: Try a shorter search, or switch to the list view to filter by status.

bundle.description: Adds the bundle to this list. Nothing on the site changes until you restore it and an approver applies it.
bundle.title: Upload a bundle

card.unpublish_description: starts answering 404 immediately. Your content is kept — this becomes a draft you can republish.

dropzone.before: Drop image files here to upload to

folders.title: Folders
folders.upload_help: Leave blank to upload into Unfiled.

grid.copy_hint: Useful for the SEO og_image field or external use
grid.delete_description: If a page still uses this asset the delete is refused, and the pages using it are named. Open the asset to see them.
grid.empty: No assets match the current filter.

history.empty: No history yet. Publish or submit to record one.
history.restore_description: Everything unsaved in the editor is overwritten by the "{event}" revision from {when}. The live page is untouched until you publish again.

import_review.applied_description: {created} created, {updated} updated. A snapshot of the previous state was taken first.
import_review.approve_description: A snapshot of the site as it stands right now is taken first, so this can be undone by restoring that one.
import_review.empty: No import is staged. Pick a snapshot and choose Restore to stage one.
import_review.reject_description: The staged restore is discarded. The site is untouched either way.
import_review.title: Review import

layout.description: Header + footer rendered on every published page.
layout.footer_empty: The footer is empty. Add blocks to it on a wider screen.
layout.header_empty: The header is empty. Add blocks to it on a wider screen.
layout.narrow_hint: Drag-and-drop layout needs width, so the canvases are read-only at this size. You can still reorder what is already in the header and footer, and save.
layout.no_history: No history yet. Save once to record one.
layout.restore_description: The header and footer in this editor are replaced by the version saved {when}. The layout is shared by every published page, so saving afterwards changes all of them.
layout.saved: Layout saved. New pages and reloads will see the change.
layout.title: Site layout

media.copy_failed: Copy failed — select the URL manually.
media.title: Media library

media_picker.empty: No uploads yet. Upload images from the Media library page.
media_picker.placeholder: Pick from library or paste a URL
media_picker.title: Pick an image

narrow.description: Drag-and-drop layout needs width, so the canvas is read-only at this size. You can still preview the draft, reorder blocks below, schedule and publish.
narrow.title: Preview and publish here, edit on a larger screen

new_page.description: A few fields, all changeable later except the language. Creating opens the editor.
new_page.language_help: Fixed once the page exists. To publish the same page in another language, add a translation from the editor's Languages tab.
new_page.parent_help: Optional. Affects the breadcrumb, not the URL. Only pages in the same language — a breadcrumb that crosses languages sends a reader out of theirs.
new_page.start_help: Templates are ordinary pages flagged as templates, so the set grows without a developer.
new_page.title: New page

outline.empty: No blocks yet. Add them on a wider screen.

pages.deleted_description: It is in the trash for 30 days.
pages.description: Drafts, scheduled drafts, published · public at /p/:slug
pages.empty: No pages yet. Click "New page" to create your first one.
pages.title: Pages
pages.unpublished_description: It is a draft again. Publish it to put it back.

pending.reject_description: It goes back to draft. The reason is shown to the editor in the page header and the revision history, so say what needs to change.
pending.reject_placeholder: The hero image is still a placeholder.
pending.title: Pending review

picker.empty: No image selected — or drag an image here
picker.not_an_image: Only image files can be dropped here.

plan.dropped_detail: Dropped: {slugs}. A redirect pointing at a page that does not exist would only produce a 404.
plan.missing_media: {count} file(s) were missing when this was taken: {files}
plan.overwrite_none: No existing page will be overwritten.
plan.untouched_one: {count} page is on this site but not in this snapshot. It will not be deleted.
plan.untouched_other: {count} pages are on this site but not in this snapshot. They will not be deleted.

row.delete_draft: It was never published, so nothing on the site changes. It goes to the trash for 30 days.
row.delete_published_after: starts answering 404 the moment you confirm. It goes to the trash for 30 days, and after that it is gone.

schedule.order_error: Unpublish time must be after publish time.
schedule.publish_help: Draft auto-publishes at this time. Cleared after the flip.
schedule.unpublish_help: Published page reverts to draft at this time.

seo.allow_indexing: Allow search engines to index this page
seo.canonical_help: Override when this page duplicates content hosted elsewhere.
seo.canonical_placeholder: Defaults to this page's own URL.
seo.json_ld_not_object: JSON-LD must be a JSON object.
seo.meta_description_placeholder: Shown in search results and link previews.
seo.meta_title_help: Leave blank to use the page title, which is right more often than not.
seo.meta_title_placeholder: Falls back to the page title
seo.no_description: No meta description — search engines will invent one from the page.
seo.no_social_image: No social image — falls back to the first image on the page
seo.social_image_help_after: , or leave blank to fall back to the first image on the page.

settings.indexing_help_after: and drops the page from the sitemap. Whether it is public at all is the publish state, set from the toolbar.
settings.nav_help: Order is set in the site layout editor.
settings.parent_help: Affects the breadcrumb, not the URL.
settings.slug_help: Changing this leaves a redirect from the old URL.
settings.slug_moved: Saving leaves a permanent redirect from {from}, so existing links keep working.
settings.title: Title

snapshot_list.delete_description: This restore point goes for good. The site is not affected — but if you were keeping this one to fall back on, download it first.
snapshot_list.empty: No snapshots yet. Take one before a big change, and this is where you come back to.
snapshot_list.pending_hint: An import is already awaiting approval
snapshot_list.staged_hint: A restore staged from this snapshot is awaiting approval

snapshots.description: Snapshot the whole site, move it between hosts, and roll back to any point.
snapshots.footnote: Restoring never deletes: a page on the site but absent from the snapshot is left alone. Branding and news articles are not part of a snapshot.
snapshots.pending_description: Nothing has changed on the site yet. Someone with approval rights has to apply it.
snapshots.pending_title: A restore is waiting for approval.
snapshots.taken_description: The site as it stands is now a restore point.
snapshots.title: Import / Export

toolbar.publish_description: It goes live immediately. The note is recorded against the revision this publish creates, and is shown in the History panel.
toolbar.publish_placeholder: Rewrote the intro and swapped the hero image.
toolbar.reject_description: The reason reaches the editor in the page header and the revision history, so say what needs to change.
toolbar.reject_placeholder: The hero image is still a placeholder.
toolbar.reject_title: Send this page back to draft?

translate.address_after: — the same slug, under the new language. Change it later in the editor.
translate.copy_help: A translator replaces the words, not the layout. Turn this off to start from an empty page instead.
translate.description: Creates a copy of this page in another language. It gets its own address, its own draft and its own approval — publishing it never publishes this one.
translate.none_left: This page already exists in every language the site publishes.
translate.title: Translate “{title}”

translations.unsaved: Save this page before adding a translation.
translations.written_in_after: . Each language has its own address, its own draft and its own approval — publishing one never publishes another.

trash.description: Deleted pages, recoverable for {days} days. After that they are removed automatically.
trash.empty_description: Deleted pages land here and stay recoverable for {days} days.
trash.purge_description: This removes the page and its revision history for good. It is the one action on this screen that the trash cannot undo.
trash.restored_description: It came back as a draft. Publish it when you are ready.
trash.title: Trash

usage.unused: Not used on any page. Deleting it will not break anything.
